svg.title: OmacVM
svg.desc: Animated overview of OmacVM: Omarchy full screen in OmacVM.app on a notched MacBook. A strip at the top stands for the macOS host behind the VM (its Wi-Fi, volume, Night Shift and the OmacVM Bridge icon); a link labelled OmacVM Bridge, on the VM network (10.0.2.2, or 192.168.77.1 on the fast network), joins it to the VM and small labelled packets travel along it. 1. Omanotch: The VM leaves a black strip beside the notch with Omarchy's bar inside the VM below it. Above the laptop the VM's invisible notch monitor fades in, where Omarchy draws its real bar. The Omanotch Mac helper streams the changed pixels down: tiles fall into the strip and the black dissolves piece by piece until the real bar fills the strip on both sides of the notch; the bar inside the VM disappears and the windows grow to full height. The pointer glides from the windows up into the strip, clicks the clock, the click travels back to the VM and Omarchy's calendar drops open right below the clock. 2. The Mac's Wi-Fi and volume travel host to VM and appear in Omarchy's bar, with a Wi-Fi menu of the Mac's networks. 3. The volume-up key on the Mac keyboard goes to the host, the bridge catches it so macOS shows no popup, the Mac's volume rises, and a volume packet makes Omarchy show its own popup; the brightness keys dim and brighten the whole MacBook screen and Omarchy shows its brightness popup. 4. A trackpad beside the laptop: OmacVM Gestures sends three-finger, pinch and four-finger touches to a virtual touchpad in the VM; three fingers go to the next workspace, a pinch zooms the web page, four fingers go back; the macOS Spaces swipe is off while the VM is full screen, and Control+Option+Escape hands the trackpad back. 5. Super+Ctrl+N toggles Omarchy's nightlight, a command goes VM to host and the Mac's Night Shift turns the whole screen warm. 6. An external display joins, and the VM's second monitor snaps into the same arrangement as in macOS System Settings.

g.text: The VM leaves a black strip beside the notch
Omanotch streams Omarchy's real bar into it
the pointer glides into the strip, clicks reach Omarchy
the Mac's Wi-Fi and sound, in Omarchy's bar
volume and brightness keys drive the Mac, Omarchy shows the popup
trackpad gestures in Omarchy, the macOS Spaces swipe off
Omarchy's nightlight runs the Mac's Night Shift
another display, the same arrangement as macOS
the VM's invisible notch monitor: Omarchy draws its real bar here
⌃⌥ Esc hands the trackpad back to macOS
